en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a large, ornate neo-baroque/neo-renaissance building along a street lined with trees and lampposts. The façade features multiple stories with arched windows, decorative statues, and an elaborate central pediment. Pedestrians are visible on the sidewalk in front. In the upper left corner, red printed text reads "Leitmeritz a. Elbe. Korps-Kommando."
